data.body: Note: this shipped in PM-9 (2026-08-10) — the transport row has a scale stepper [− 1× +] beside the export key; exports at 2×/4× are exact nearest-neighbor upscales and the LCD shows the output size (e.g. 'out 192×192'). The copied CSS follows the chosen scale too. If the existing stepper covers the need, this can be closed as duplicate; if you'd rather have dedicated 'export 2x'/'export 4x' keys instead, say so and it becomes a UI change. (Status was briefly moved to in_planning by an orchestrator ID-collision mistake — routing to needs_human for your call.)
